component_evidence.scientific_disposition: The component arm is consumed and must not be replayed. It is positive target-runtime evidence, not endpoint performance.

endpoint_packet.workload: c32, 4214 prompt tokens, 358 output tokens, 535 shared-prefix tokens, temperature zero

owner_transition.policy: Prepare and hash-bind the endpoint-only owner first. Then stop only the matching PID/start_ticks predecessor and immediately launch the replacement through research/factory/tools/detached-owner --unit-manager pid inside the existing claim.

allowed_changes: Implement the production SGLang v0.5.13 integration in this project from post-RoPE global KV writes through incremental summary state, request ownership, positions, and the actual global-attention consumer for prefill, TARGET_VERIFY, and decode.
Leave all five sliding-window layers in every six-layer cycle on the stock exact consumer. Route only global-attention layers through the accepted multi-resolution candidate.
Create an endpoint-only path in h200_endpoint_owner.sh that adopts the settled component result and never replays it.

Mechanically stage the exact checkpoint from the bound local root by the bound manifest, transferring only missing or mismatched files to temporary names before hash verification and atomic finalization.
Reuse the already pulled runtime image and current claim. Stage the exact runner and the smallest project-local endpoint hook/owner bytes, then launch stock before candidate.

Persist and retrieve the complete stock terminal before starting candidate. Persist complete requests, request hashes, token and cache accounting, service time, p95, failures, compact-entry/fallback/request-ownership telemetry, and the candidate terminal before release.
Repair ordinary pre-science staging, import, API, hook, server-health, or retrieval defects in this same claim while the absolute release window still fits.
must_not: modify the historical qualified-control project or its artifacts
change checkpoint, tokenizer, runtime image, workload, concurrency, sampling, local-attention semantics, layer count, hidden width, comparison order, or scientific submission count
credit the component timing as endpoint performance
use provider APIs or create, delete, or replace a provider resource

scientific_contract.candidate_semantics: Quality-unsafe proxy: every token and full-width layer remains, local windows remain exact, and only older state presented to global attention is summarized.
scientific_contract.endpoint_eligibility: Run one stock-then-candidate exact c32 pair because the accepted component passes the compact-entry, fallback, finiteness, and request-ownership gates.
scientific_contract.promotion: Only a complete candidate endpoint at or below 0.500119281574996 seconds/request can satisfy the latency portion of the campaign objective; quality and sustainable-cost qualification remain separate.
